name: Macau
summary: Macau taxes individuals only on employment and business income: professional tax is at most 12%, and complementary tax 12% on business profits. It does not tax capital gains, dividends or interest received by individuals, and has no inheritance, gift or wealth tax. It became formally territorial from 2026. The treaty network is tiny (no US treaty). Residence for foreigners is mainly through talent and employment schemes; the old investment-residence scheme for property buyers was suspended in 2007.

regimes.name: Macau resident
regimes.description: Only employment and business income are taxed; no tax on capital gains, dividends, inheritances or wealth.
regimes.eligibility: Residence and domicile are irrelevant for professional tax (PwC). Living in Macau requires a residence authorisation.

capital_gains.summary: Macau has no capital gains tax for individuals: capital gains and investment income are not taxable to individual recipients (PwC). Individuals are taxed only on employment income (professional tax, max 12%). From 1 January 2026 Macau formally moved to territorial taxation.
capital_gains.important_exceptions: Stamp duty applies to transfers of Macau real estate (purchaser) and special stamp duties on short-term resales of residential property have existed; current rates not verified. Dealing in property or securities as a business is subject to complementary tax (12% above the threshold).

sources.title: Macau SAR - Corporate - Taxes on corporate income

capital_gains.rate_basis: No tax on capital gains of individuals (PwC Income determination).
capital_gains.professional_trader: A business of trading is subject to complementary tax at up to 12%.

dividends.summary: Dividends are not taxed in the hands of individuals; dividends of Macau companies are covered by complementary tax at company level (PwC). Foreign dividends are untaxed.

sources.title: Macau SAR - Individual - Foreign tax relief and tax treaties

dividends.withholding_outbound: No dividend WHT (general knowledge, not verified).
dividends.treaty_network: Comprehensive arrangements with Mainland China, Hong Kong, Portugal, Cabo Verde, Cambodia, Mozambique and Vietnam only; Belgium signed (PwC). No treaty with the US, so US dividends bear 30% US WHT.
dividends.holding_company_notes: Complementary tax 12% above the tax-free threshold (MOP 600,000 for 2025 income under the 2026 Budget); territorial from 2026 except for MNE constituent entities.

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Urban property tax on Macau real estate (on rental income or assessed rental value; rates and owner-occupier reliefs not verified). Stamp duty on property purchases.

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift taxes (PwC). The former succession and gift tax was abolished in 2001 (general knowledge).
inheritance.gift_tax: None. Stamp duty may apply to gratuitous transfers of Macau real estate (rates not verified).

residency.tax_residency_test: No residence test is relevant for individuals: professional tax applies to Macau employment income regardless of residence; investment income is not taxed (PwC).

routes.name: Talent programme / employment / significant investment residence authorisation
routes.requirements: Residence authorisation through the talent-introduction scheme, employment, or significant investment/management projects approved by IPIM; the property-purchase route was suspended in 2007 (details not verified). Portuguese citizens have historical links but no automatic right.

corporate.summary: Complementary tax: progressive to 12% on taxable profits; tax-free threshold raised to MOP 600,000 for 2025 income by the 2026 Budget; territorial taxation from 1 January 2026 except foreign income of MNE constituent entities.

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain fully US-taxed; Macau does not tax their investment income, so the US layer is the full cost. No treaty.
open_questions: Residence routes for a non-working investor family were not verified with IPIM/PSP.
Property stamp duties and urban property tax rates not verified.
